lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Discrete high-luminance circular clusters are organized into approximately five visible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The spacing between centroids increases along the anterior-posterior axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical linear regions of increased pixel intensity coincide with the spatial positions of the circular blobs, forming a discernible grid structure across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A singular prominent linear feature runs horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank, exhibiting a sharp luminance transition with higher pixel values on the dorsal side and lower values on the ventral side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant vertical indentation or elongated depression is visible immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit, spanning the vertical height of the visible flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple high-chroma yellow-hued objects with distinct vertical bands are present in the water column anterior and dorsal to the shark's head. A thin, high-luminance horizontal feature is present on the posterior-right region of the flank.
